subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should a workflow/security owner accept these fourteen upstream GitHub Action revisions for the credential-bearing, release, CodeQL, stale, and Codex-agent workflows after the rebased head has completed its checks?
rationale: The diff is mechanically narrow, but it changes third-party code that executes under repository credentials and release permissions; that trust decision cannot safely be inferred from Dependabot metadata or ordinary code review alone.

options.title: Accept after exact-head validation
options.body: Review the upstream revisions and merge only after the rebased head completes the required workflow checks successfully.

options.title: Hold selected credentialed updates
options.body: Split out or defer the action revisions used with app keys, registry credentials, or OpenAI secrets if their upstream changes are not acceptable yet.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head validation
recommendation.body: Review the upstream revisions and merge only after the rebased head completes the required workflow checks successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely owner for the repository-level workflow and supply-chain acceptance decision under the applicable CI/security review policy.
